Decibel Meter

Measure sound levels with your microphone — live dB readout with peak hold.

—
dB (relative)
—
Peak hold

Honest note: this meter is relative and uncalibrated — every microphone is different and browsers don't know its sensitivity. Use it to compare loudness (quieter vs louder), not for absolute measurements. Microphone audio is processed locally and never recorded or sent anywhere. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start and allow microphone access.
  2. Watch the live dB meter.
  3. Press Stop when done.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the dB value computed?

It measures RMS energy from your microphone and converts it to a relative dB value.

Is the reading calibrated?

No — every microphone is different and browsers don't know the calibration. Use it to compare relative loudness, not for absolute measurements.

What does the display show?

A large live meter, a numeric readout, and a peak-hold marker that resets automatically.
